public.title: Daily Temperatures
public.description: For each day return the number of days until a strictly warmer temperature. Return 0 if no warmer future day exists. There are 0 to 1000 integer temperatures from -100 through 150.
hints: Store unresolved indices in a decreasing temperature stack.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: A warmer day resolves all smaller temperatures at the stack top. Each index enters and leaves the stack once, for O(n) time.
